title: ORAV OTT JA HIIR HELMI MAALIVAD

characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike pruun orav koheva sabaga, seljas väike roheline vest, suured uudishimulikud silmad ja sõbralik rõõmsameelne näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: HIIR HELMI
characters.description: Väike hall hiir suurte ümarate kõrvadega, seljas väike kollane kleit, roosa lipsuke pea peal, suured säravad silmad ja armas naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: JÕE ÄÄR
locations.description: A sunny riverbank with clear blue water and lush green grass. Tall, varied green trees line the distant river edge. In the foreground, near the water, there is a small, simple light wooden picnic table. Smooth, rounded grey rocks are scattered on the grass and by the water. The atmosphere is cheerful and peaceful. Cartoon style.

pages.text: ORAV OTT JA HIIR HELMI ON JÕE ÄÄRES.
pages.scene: Orav Ott and Hiir Helmi stand on a sunny riverbank with clear blue water and lush green grass. Tall green trees are in the background. Ott has his paws together, looking towards the river. Helmi stands next to him, looking at Ott, smiling. A small wooden picnic table is visible nearby. Smooth grey rocks are scattered on the grass. Cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Hiir Helmi stand on a sunny riverbank. Ott is gesturing excitedly with one paw, a big smile on his face, looking at Helmi. Helmi looks at Ott with wide, curious eyes and a thoughtful expression. A small wooden picnic table is visible nearby. Smooth grey rocks are scattered on the grass. Cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Hiir Helmi are kneeling on the lush green grass of a sunny riverbank, picking up smooth grey rocks from the ground. Ott holds a few rocks in his paws, smiling. Helmi carefully picks up a rock with both paws. The small wooden picnic table is in the background. Clear blue water and green trees are visible. Cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott stands at the small wooden picnic table on the sunny riverbank, placing small pots of colorful paint onto its surface. He holds a red paint pot in one paw. Hiir Helmi sits at the table, looking at the paints with excitement. Smooth grey rocks are already on the table. Clear blue water and green trees are visible. Cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

Hiir Helmi sits at the small wooden picnic table on the sunny riverbank, holding a small paintbrush in her paws. She looks intently at a pot of blue paint on the table. Orav Ott stands next to her, watching with a gentle smile. Several smooth grey rocks and various paint pots are on the table. Clear blue water and green trees are visible. Cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Hiir Helmi are sitting at the small wooden picnic table on the sunny riverbank, busy painting rocks. Ott is painting a smooth grey rock red with his brush. Helmi is also painting a rock red. Colorful paint pots and other unpainted rocks are on the table. Clear blue water and green trees are visible. Cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Hiir Helmi are sitting at the small wooden picnic table on the sunny riverbank, continuing to paint rocks. Ott is painting a smooth grey rock blue with his brush. Helmi is also painting a rock blue. Some red-painted rocks are now drying on the table alongside colorful paint pots and unpainted rocks. Clear blue water and green trees are visible. Cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Hiir Helmi stand proudly beside the small wooden picnic table on the sunny riverbank, admiring their painted rocks. The table is covered with many beautifully painted rocks in various bright colors like red and blue, drying in the sun. Ott claps his paws. Helmi smiles widely. Clear blue water and green trees are visible. Cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Hiir Helmi are carefully arranging their beautifully painted rocks into a neat stack or line on the edge of the small wooden picnic table on the sunny riverbank. Ott places a blue-painted rock on top of a red-painted rock. Helmi holds another colorful rock, ready to add it. Clear blue water and green trees are visible. Cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Hiir Helmi are sitting on the lush green grass beside their collection of beautifully painted and arranged rocks, which are neatly stacked on the small wooden picnic table. Both friends are smiling broadly and looking at their artwork with immense satisfaction. They hug each other gently. Clear blue water and green trees are visible. Cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.
